message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical technique used for binary classification. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., “yes” vs. “no”) by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model’s parameters are estimated by maximizing the likelihood of observing the training data, and once fitted, it can predict class probabilities for new observations.
